request.lesson: When an ADR lists more decision drivers than the criteria that actually discriminated between the options, split the section: name the decisive criteria first, then list the criteria that were evaluated but did not discriminate, and say so. Keeping every evaluated criterion in one flat list makes the record look like it rests on broader grounds than it does, and it lets an alternative be rejected against a criterion that never separated the options.

A contract-alignment linter that resolves criterion references gives false assurance on a densely cross-referenced spec. lint-contract-item-alignment.py catches a dangling AC reference and was green after every amendment round, while the document accumulated: a prose row count disagreeing with the table it introduces, a criterion asserting a value on an axis its twin had been migrated off, table columns bound by no criterion, and a criterion quantifying over a table row that carries no label. Those are semantic-coupling defects and no checker covers them. A small checker that verifies stated counts against their tables, that every italicised table citation resolves to a heading or bold label or Canonical-values row, and that axis-table identifiers are named by some criterion reproduces one of the adjudicated defects with zero false positives. Build it before amending a spec of this size; the mechanical invariants passing is not evidence the amendments were sound.

The remedy for a perturbation-prone criterion is to repair only what severity requires and defer the rest with citations, rather than spot-fixing every finding. On Connect and Orient this converted a rising finding count into closure: round 19 repaired only its Blocker and its Concern and deferred four Nits with per-finding citations, and round 20 then sustained one Nit and no Blocker or Concern. The exit condition that makes this safe is that a review may proceed when no unresolved Blocker or Concern remains, so a result carrying only deferred Nits recorded with their citations is a pass; chasing an absolute clean sentinel across advisory wording items does not converge. Two further habits carried the same weight. Repair the generator rather than the symptom: where a derivation clause sat on one of two criteria citing a shared class definition, mirroring it onto the sibling had already produced the identical drift in reverse, and moving it into the class definition both criteria cite cannot re-drift. And batch deferred items into the next amendment window that has to happen anyway, since the window is a zero-cost moment for a fix that would otherwise cost its own round.
